investigation: Existing interaction had a separate PeerConnection/DataChannel/signaling/UUID, but consent, command relay, screen coordinates and teardown depended on broadcast/viewer/voice state. Coupling confirmed; the exact causes of the original physical-PC Windows errors cannot be established from the screenshots alone.
limitations: Two isolated packaged clients on one physical Windows PC, not two physical PCs.
Viewer pointer/text use trusted Chromium input; microphone/shortcuts/wheel are synthetic.
Native dialog approval is replaced only in the owned test process; helper is constrained to the owned fixture.
External NAT/TURN, secure desktop/lock transitions and real UAC prompts are not automated.
AnyDesk processes were present; their presence is not evidence of physical two-PC acceptance.
publication: Backend deployment awaits explicit approval; stable desktop publication and previous-package updater test follow the validated backend deployment.
